dial: Black with luminous Arabic numerals and markers. Date at 3 o’clock, seconds at 9 o’clock.
crystal: Sapphire, formed of corundum, 3.5 mm thick, magnifying lens over the date at 3 o’clock. Anti-reflective coating.
movement_note: Automatic mechanical, exclusive Panerai OP III calibre, 13¼ lignes, 21 jewels, PANERAI personalised oscillating weight. Glucydur® balance, 28,800 alternations/hour. Incabloc® anti-shock device. Power reserve 42 hours. Côtes de Genève decoration on the bridges. It is tested and certified by C.O.S.C.
bracelet: PANERAI personalised alligator strap and brushed steel adjustable buckle. Supplied with a tool for changing the strap and a steel screwdriver.
